name: Fall Of Man
overview: The Fall of Man is introduced in Genesis where God commands Adam not to eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, warning that disobedience would result in death. The serpent, described as more subtle than any beast God made, deceives the woman by contradicting God's warning and assuring her that death would not follow eating the forbidden fruit. This exchange highlights the pivotal moment of human disobedience and the introduction of sin and death into the world, underscoring the seriousness of God's command and the consequences of rebellion.
